He took the key downstairs, though he knew it fitted no lock in the lighthouse.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯照着空荡的街口，雨水在井盖边积成细碎的银光。早餐店亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽悄悄爬上玻璃。清洁工推着车经过，扫帚摩擦地面的声音格外清楚。远处一辆夜班车缓缓停下，有人拢紧衣领，有人低头看手机。天还没亮，生活已经开始翻页。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same method on a smaller version of it.\n- Imagine opening a box that holds a smaller box, then opening that box the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you find a box with no smaller box inside."}
